title: Community Discs reborn
description: This mod adds a whole array of new music discs made by the fandom themselves. Discs like Not Dead Yet add dark and sinister tones which contrast with the joyful Miniature Adventure.
body:
[DISCLAIMER]
During porting to new versions, errors occured. Meaning that some mods may have bugs in that should be reported
[CREDITS]
This mod adds new and amazingly refined artworks of music from creators like TenM - https://www.youtube.com/@TenM and Laudvindi - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTIkTFLZVbxuDZvTynhv2uw

This mod is not entirely finished so expect many bugs and updates!

Command usage:
/communitydiscs
- credits. Shows the creators of the music
- grant. Grants access to discs
- revoke. Revokes access to having the discs
- give. Gives a genre or specific disc
